title: Material and size.
officialText: Exhaust ducts shall have a smooth interior finish and shall be constructed of metal that is a minimum of 0.016 inches (0.4 mm) thick. The exhaust duct size shall be 4 inches minimum (102 mm) nominal diameter, unless a larger duct size is specifically required by the dryer manufacturer.
